segments.sn1.50:2.1: “Ke ca te ataruṃ paṅkaṃ [saṅgaṃ (sī. syā.)], maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ;
segments.sn1.50:2.3: Ke hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun”ti.
segments.sn1.50:3.1: “Upako palagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo;
segments.sn1.50:3.3: Bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bāhuraggi ca siṅgiyo [bahudantī ca piṅgayo (sī.)];
segments.sn1.50:3.5: Te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun”ti.
segments.sn1.50:6.3: Taṃ te dhammaṃ idhaññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan”ti.
segments.sn1.50:7.3: Kassa tvaṃ dhammamaññāya, vācaṃ bhāsasi īdisan”ti.
segments.sn1.50:8.1: “Kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge [vehaḷiṅge (sī.), vebhaḷiṅge (syā. kaṃ.)] ghaṭīkaro;
segments.sn1.50:9.3: Ahuvā te sagāmeyyo, ahuvā te pure sakhā.
segments.sn1.50:12.3: Ahuvā me sagāmeyyo, ahuvā me pure sakhā”ti.

lines: Kusalī bhāsasī tesanti,“kusalan”ti idaṃ vacanaṃ imassa atthīti kusalī, tesaṃ therānaṃ tvaṃ kusalaṃ anavajjaṃ bhāsasi, thomesi pasaṃsasi, paṇḍitosi devaputtāti vadati.
Taṃ te dhammaṃ idhaññāyāti te therā taṃ dhammaṃ idha tumhākaṃ sāsane jānitvā.
Brahmacārī nirāmisoti nirāmisabrahmacārī nāma anāgāmī, anāgāmī ahosinti attho.
“Upapannāse”ti se-kārāgamaṃ katvā niddeso,“upapannā” icceva atthoti āha “nibbattivasena upagatā”ti.
Attano sampattito avihānato avihā, tesaṃ brahmaloko avihābrahmaloko, tasmiṃ.
Mānusaṃ dehaṃ samatikkamanti cittupakkilesapahānavasenāti phalena hetudassanamidanti āha “mānusaṃ dehanti idha … pe … vuttānī”ti.
Tattha saṃyojanakoti vuttaṃ “dibbaṃ yoganti pañca uddhambhāgiyasaṃyojanānī”ti.
“Hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun”ti tesaṃ tvaṃ kusalaṃ sabbāvajjappahānena anavajjataṃ bhāsatīti kusalī vadesi.
Atthena saddassa abhedopacāraṃ katvā gambhīravacanaṃ vuttanti āha “gambhīratthan”ti atthasseva gambhīrato, na saddassa.
Nivāsanaṭṭhānabhūto samāno eko gāmo etassāti āha “ekagāmavāsī”ti.
